Bacterial diseases - Aeromoniasis.symptoms: Hemorrhages on skin, body ulcers, exophthalmia (pop-eye), swollen abdomen.
Bacterial diseases - Aeromoniasis.bfri_treatment: Apply Oxytetrasyline (50-75 mg/kg fish body weight) mixed with feed daily for 7-10 days. Disinfect pond with Lime (CaCO3) at 1 kg/decimal.
Bacterial diseases - Aeromoniasis.water_remediation: Perform 30% water exchange. Increase dissolved oxygen above 5.0 mg/L.

Bacterial gill disease.symptoms: Swollen and pale gills, excessive mucus secretion, piping at surface.
Bacterial gill disease.bfri_treatment: Salt bath treatment (1-2% NaCl solution for 10-15 mins) or Potassium Permanganate (KMnO4) at 2-3 ppm whole pond treatment.
Bacterial gill disease.water_remediation: Reduce organic load by clearing uneaten feed. Maintain ammonia below 0.05 mg/L.

EUS.symptoms: Deep red necrotizing ulcers on head, body, and tail.
EUS.bfri_treatment: Apply CIFAX at 1 liter/hectare (1 meter depth) or Lime (CaCO3) at 1 kg/decimal alongside Salt at 1 kg/decimal.
EUS.water_remediation: Stabilize pH between 7.5 and 8.5. Avoid cold water stress.

WSSV.symptoms: White spots/patches on carapace, reddish body discoloration, lethargy in shrimp.
WSSV.bfri_treatment: No cure for acute viral infection. Immediately isolate infected ponds using biological security barriers. Apply Probiotics to suppress viral spread.
WSSV.water_remediation: Disinfect intake water with Chlorine (30 ppm) before filling culture ponds. Maintain DO > 5.0 mg/L.
